# apple_subscription_groups (Data Source)

Lists the subscription groups belonging to an app.

`app_id` is required because Apple publishes no top-level subscription group collection — a group is reachable only through the app that owns it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_apps" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}

# app_id is required: Apple publishes no top-level subscription group
# collection, so a group is reachable only through the app that owns it.
data "apple_subscription_groups" "all" {
  app_id = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
}

# reference_name_pattern is a regular expression matched as a substring.
data "apple_subscription_groups" "premium" {
  app_id                 = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
  reference_name_pattern = "^Premium$"
}

data "apple_subscription_groups" "sorted" {
  app_id     = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
  sort_by    = "reference_name"
  sort_order = "desc"
  limit      = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The Apple ID of the app whose subscription groups to list. Obtain it from the `apple_apps` data source.

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of subscription groups to return. Applied after filtering and sorting.
- `reference_name_pattern` (String) Regular expression matched against each group's reference name. Matches as a substring unless anchored with `^` and `$`.
- `sort_by` (String) Field to sort by: `reference_name` (default) or `id`.
- `sort_order` (String) Sort direction: `asc` (default) or `desc`.

### Read-Only

- `filtered_count` (Number) Number of subscription groups remaining after filtering, before the limit.
- `subscription_groups` (Attributes List) The subscription groups matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscription_groups))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of subscription groups on the app before filtering.

<a id="nestedatt--subscription_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscription_groups`

Read-Only:

- `app_id` (String) The app the group belongs to. Echoed from the `app_id` argument: Apple's group response carries no app linkage.
- `id` (String) The unique Apple-generated identifier for the subscription group.
- `reference_name` (String) The internal name of the subscription group.
